why: U+3164 HANGUL FILLER is a valid JavaScript identifier character that renders as blank, so two identifiers that look identical in review are different bindings. The fail side is src/a.mjs whose identifier carries one U+3164 in the middle; the pass side is the same line without it. Code files get the single-character-literal concession, and this case pins that the concession stops at literals: widen it to any code context and the fail side goes green.
